major_findings: The 53-vertex GIS shell is visibly traced to Purdue GIS OBJECTID 615, but campus GIS is not a surveyed facade line and the conversion is approximate.
Identity root and portable material/image checks pass; the master placement marker was not reviewed.
R3 makes the recessed glazed vestibule and door sets legible and restores masonry above the entry.
The portico, columns, upper facade, and stair rails remain schematic relative to the Purdue photo; support/rail geometry reads awkwardly in the front render.
The roof is a large plain slab with generic rooftop masses; roof and height remain estimates without dimensioned elevation evidence.
No R3 interior cutaway was supplied. Interior module offsets remain approximate because the 2024 Road School floor diagrams have no scale or north arrow.
